title: CMPSS
text: Compare two input voltages on comparator pins, 5 inputs, 2 outputs, {Comparator module} sets Indicates which module to use; {Second input} sets the source of second input, {DAC source select} sets the source of internal DAC, {Specify DAC/RAMP parameter(s) via} sets the configure source DAC/RAMP value source, {DAC value (DACH)}, {DAC initial value}, {RAMP reference value}, {RAMP decrement value}, {RAMP delay value}, {RAMP initial reference value}, {RAMP initial decrement value} sets the rAMP decrement value, {RAMP initial delay value} sets the rAMP delay value, {Enable latch output} sets the comparator latch output, {Enable latch clear} sets the clear comparator latch value and {Sample time} sets the frequency at which data is read. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Comparator module
params.values: Indicates which module to use CMPSS1_COMPH (default) | CMPSSx_COMPL | CMPSSx_COMPH | where x ranges from 1 to 8

params.name: Second input
params.values: Source of second input pin External pin (default) | Internal DAC

params.name: DAC source select
params.values: Source of internal DAC DAC module (default) | RAMP module

params.name: Specify DAC/RAMP parameter(s) via
params.values: Configure source DAC/RAMP value source Dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Enable latch clear
params.values: Clear comparator latch value off (default) | on

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Frequency at which data is read from comparator 0.1 (default)
